HediffDef.label: unstable mutation
HediffDef.description: Forces an unstable mutation on this person. This mutation will activate a new random gene for 12 hours. After that period passes, the gene will deactivate.

HediffDef.label: unstable mutation, minor
HediffDef.description: Forces an uncontrollable and unstable mutation on this person every day. This mutation will activate three new random genes for a whole day. Next day, new genes will take their place. The genes will only deactivate if they are an xenogene. Endogenes will persist.

HediffDef.label: unstable mutation, major
HediffDef.description: Forces an uncontrollable and unstable mutation on this person every day. This mutation will activate four new random genes for a whole day. Next day, new genes will take their place. The genes will only deactivate if they are an xenogene. Endogenes will persist.

HediffDef.label: unstable mutation, catastrophic
HediffDef.description: Forces an uncontrollable and unstable mutation on this person every day. This mutation will activate twelve new random genes for a whole day. Next day, new genes will take their place. The genes will only deactivate if they are an xenogene. Endogenes will persist.

HediffDef.label: unstable mutation, positive
HediffDef.description: Forces an uncontrollable and unstable mutation on this person every day. This mutation will activate twelve new random genes for a whole day. Next day, new genes will take their place. The genes will only deactivate if they are an xenogene. Endogenes will persist.
